findings.detail: The extracted cost for 360 Holdco delayed draw is -32000, but the SOI row shows amortized cost as a dash and fair value as (32), so the negative fair value was stored as cost.

rationale: C107 flagged negative cost rows. Raw source confirms at least one flagged cost is not a legitimate negative cost: for 360 Holdco delayed draw, the SOI row places a dash in amortized cost and (32) in fair value, while the extracted holding has cost -32000. The filing total also ties the extracted fair value total, so this is localized to row/column extraction rather than an aggregate anchor issue. Some other delayed-draw rows, such as ARC Health OPCO, do show negative amortized cost in source, but the 360 Holdco row grounds a real data error in the flagged set.
